summary: Implemented the gitmap tree-search command family (wildcard, startsWith, contains, endsWith, grep) and the tree-learn SQLite Split DB engine (.gitmap/data/treedb/sql.db). Includes multi-format tree file parser (.txt ASCII tree with directory stack + flat paths, .json FolderReport and FolderTreeExportDoc, and .yaml), ANSI terminal help screens, CLI argument and flag parser, routing dispatch in dispatch_folder_tree.go and roottooling.go, and comprehensive unit tests.
verification: Targeted test 'go test -v ./cmdfoldertree' in cli passed all 18 tests in 0.080s with 0 failures, and 'go vet ./cmdfoldertree' passed with 0 warnings.

acceptance.VG-05: PASS: gitmap tree-search evaluates wildcard glob patterns (* and ?) case-insensitively across paths and file names.
acceptance.VG-06: PASS: gitmap tree-search-startsWith evaluates prefix matching while preserving relative folder hierarchy paths.
acceptance.VG-07: PASS: gitmap tree-search-contains evaluates case-insensitive substring searching across relative paths and file names.
acceptance.VG-08: PASS: gitmap tree-search-endsWith evaluates suffix matching and file extensions.
acceptance.VG-09: PASS: gitmap tree-search-grep evaluates regular expressions against relative paths with graceful error handling on invalid syntax.
acceptance.VG-10: PASS: gitmap tree-learn parses tree files and ingests records into .gitmap/data/treedb/sql.db with WAL mode, TreeFile schema, and case-insensitive indexes in an atomic transaction.
